correctness.rationale: Contracting each open path and removing already closed cycles gives the stated weighted completion quotient. I checked the loop counts for increasing triples and the peak counts including the two allowable single transpositions, one three-cycle and one loop-plus-transposition possibility. These counts apply already at size 3, needed when n=4. Reversal conjugation preserves Ewens weights and exchanges peak with valley after relocating the window. Deletion of j leaves the same Ewens weight on n-1 indices up to a constant factor, preserves the order of images and leaves the window consecutive. This gives covariance as theta/(theta+n-1) times the size difference of the marginal. Independent symbolic factoring of those differences times the common denominator gave theta^2*(theta-1)*(n+2*theta-3), -theta^2*(n-5)*(theta-1), and -theta^2*(theta-1)*(theta+1) for U,D,P/V. The denominator is strictly positive, so the signs, zeros and large-size powers follow; n=5 is a zero covariance for D, not a general independence claim about the entire triple law. The frozen checker was read, not executed.
